title: Price Coordination with Asymmetric Information Sharing: Theory and Evidence
Competition and Quality Choice in Hospital Markets

Market Power in California's Gasoline Market
abstract: In recent months, prices for California's special (CaRFG) gasoline have again exceeded U.S. average prices by much more than the difference in production costs. A number of observers have attributed the widening average differential to increasing scarcity of refinery capacity among plants that are equipped to manufacture CaRFG gasoline. While these arguments have generally been sound, the dismissals of market power concerns have not been well supported. We study the potential for firms in the CaRFG wholesale gasoline industry to exercise market power, examining the refining, importation and storage of the fuel. We don't dispute arguments that the elevated prices are consistent with competitive markets, but we illustrate that the data are also consistent with some firms exercising market power. We then discuss methods for, and difficulties in, distinguishing between competitive pricing and market power.
abstract_zh: 近几个月来，加州特种汽油（CaRFG）的价格再次大幅高于美国平均价格，其幅度远超生产成本的差异。许多观察人士将平均价差的扩大归因于能够生产CaRFG汽油的炼油厂产能日益稀缺。尽管这些论点总体上是合理的，但对市场势力担忧的驳斥却缺乏充分依据。我们研究了CaRFG批发汽油行业中企业行使市场势力的可能性，考察了该燃料的炼制、进口和储存环节。我们并不否认高价格与竞争性市场相一致的论点，但我们说明，数据同样与部分企业行使市场势力相一致。随后，我们讨论了区分竞争性定价与市场势力的方法及其困难。

title: Negotiating Coordination: A Study in Retail Gasoline
abstract: We examine a unique five-year equilibrium transition in the retail gasoline industry using hourly station-level price data. In an attempt to increase profit margins under a focal pricing structure, price leaders alter asymmetrically sized retailers' incentives to coordinate on prices, spurring bargaining over transfers that support coordination. Such bargaining occurs in near real-time through platform-enabled, price-based communication under strategic uncertainty. After three turbulent years of bargaining without resolution, which entail multiple price wars and experimentation that enable firms to reveal their pricing strategies and learn rivals', price leaders gradually adapt to a new price-signaling structure that ultimately yields stable, shared long-run profit growth. We discuss implications for the theory of collusion and for antitrust policies aimed at limiting the anticompetitive effects of digital information-sharing and pricing algorithms.
abstract_zh: 我们利用小时级的加油站层面价格数据，考察了零售汽油行业一次为期五年的均衡转型。为了在焦点定价结构下提高利润率，价格领导者改变了规模不对称的零售商协调定价的激励，从而引发了围绕支持协调的转移支付的讨价还价。这种讨价还价在战略不确定性下，通过平台支持的、基于价格的实时沟通进行。在经历了三年动荡的、未得到解决的讨价还价（期间出现多次价格战和试验，使企业得以揭示其定价策略并了解竞争对手）之后，价格领导者逐渐适应了新的价格信号结构，最终实现了稳定、共享的长期利润增长。我们讨论了其对合谋理论的启示，以及对旨在限制数字信息共享和定价算法反竞争效应的反垄断政策的启示。

title: New Evidence on How Much Electric Vehicles are Driven
Asymmetric Information Sharing in Oligopoly: A Natural Experiment in Retail Gasoline
abstract: Using a natural experiment from a retail gasoline antitrust case, we study how asymmetric information sharing affects oligopoly pricing. Empirically, price competition softens when, following case settlement, information sharing shifts from symmetric to asymmetric, with one firm losing access to high-frequency granular rival price data. We provide theory and empirics illustrating how strategic ignorance creates price commitment, leading to higher price-cost margins. Using a structural model, we find substantial profit-enhancing effects of asymmetric information sharing. These results provide a cautionary tale for antitrust agencies regarding the potential unintended consequences of limiting price information sharing among firms.
abstract_zh: 利用一起零售汽油反垄断案件的自然实验，我们研究了不对称信息共享如何影响寡头定价。实证结果表明，在案件和解之后，当信息共享由对称转为不对称，即其中一家企业失去获取高频、细粒度竞争对手价格数据的渠道时，价格竞争会减弱。我们提供了理论与实证分析，说明战略性无知如何形成价格承诺，从而导致更高的价格—成本加成。利用结构模型，我们发现不对称信息共享具有显著的增利效应。这些结果为反垄断机构提供了一个警示，即限制企业间价格信息共享可能带来意想不到的后果。

title: Consumer Search with Learning in the Retail Gasoline Market
abstract: This article estimates a model of optimal search where consumers learn the distribution of gasoline prices during their driving trips. Our model incorporates traffic information and leverages this ordered search environment to recover parameters of the search and learning process using only station‐level price and market share data. We find that learning is a crucial component of search in this market. Consumers' prior beliefs regularly deviate from the true price distribution but are updated quickly following each new price observation. Counterfactuals reveal how these learning dynamics generate asymmetric search patterns commonly associated with asymmetric cost pass‐through.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了一个最优搜寻模型，其中消费者在驾车出行的过程中学习汽油价格的分布。我们的模型纳入了交通信息，并利用这种有序搜寻环境，仅使用加油站层面的价格和市场份额数据来恢复搜寻与学习过程的参数。我们发现，在该市场中，学习是搜寻的关键组成部分。消费者的先验信念经常偏离真实的价格分布，但在每次观察到新价格后都会迅速更新。反事实分析揭示了这些学习动态如何产生通常与成本不对称传导相关的不对称搜寻模式。

Odd Prices at Retail Gasoline Stations: Focal Point Pricing and Tacit Collusion
venue: Journal of Economics and Management Strategy
abstract: This study empirically investigates the theory that odd‐numbered pricing points can be used as focal points to facilitate tacit collusion. Like other retailers, gasoline stations in the United States disproportionately sell at prices ending in odd digits. I show that station prices are higher and change less frequently in locations using more odd prices (particularly those ending in 5 or 9), even after controlling for other market characteristics. The evidence suggests that the use of pricing points can be an effective mechanism for tacitly coordinating prices, providing an alternative explanation for the widespread use of odd prices in retail markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究实证检验了如下理论：以奇数结尾的价格点可以作为焦点，促进默契合谋。与其他零售商一样，美国的加油站也不成比例地以尾数为奇数的价格出售商品。我在控制其他市场特征之后仍发现，在更多使用奇数价格（尤其是以5或9结尾的价格）的地点，加油站价格更高，且价格调整频率更低。证据表明，使用价格点可以成为默契协调价格的有效机制，这为零售市场中奇数价格的普遍使用提供了另一种解释。

title: The Speed of Gasoline Price Response in Markets with and without Edgeworth Cycles
abstract: Retail gasoline prices are known to respond fairly slowly to wholesale price changes. This does not appear to be true for markets with Edgeworth price cycles. Recently many retail gasoline markets in the midwestern United States and other countries have been shown to exhibit price cycles in which competition generates rapid cyclical retail price movements. We show that cost changes in cycling markets are passed on two to three times faster than in markets without cycles. We argue that the constant price movement inherent within the Edgeworth cycle eliminates price frictions and allows firms to pass on cost fluctuations more easily.
abstract_zh: 众所周知，零售汽油价格对批发价格变动的反应相当缓慢。但在存在埃奇沃思价格周期（Edgeworth price cycles）的市场中，情况并非如此。近年来，美国中西部地区及其他国家的许多零售汽油市场都被证明存在价格周期，即竞争会产生快速的周期性零售价格波动。我们表明，在存在周期的市场中，成本变动的传导速度是无周期市场的两到三倍。我们认为，埃奇沃思周期中固有的持续价格波动消除了价格摩擦，使企业能够更容易地传导成本波动。
